"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if np.any(np.isnan(arr)) or np.any(np.isinf(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} is empty")

    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_raw = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if sum_raw == 0:
        # Edge case: if future_horizon is 0 or all weights zero, set uniform
        normalized_weights = np.ones(future_horizon) / future_horizon if future_horizon > 0 else np.array([])
    else:
        normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_raw

    # Weighted log-likelihoods
    weighted_with = logp_with_result @ normalized_weights
    weighted_call = logp_call_only @ normalized_weights
    weighted_no = logp_no_call @ normalized_weights

    # Margin: improvement over the best alternative
    best_alternative = np.maximum(weighted_no, weighted_call)
    margin = weighted_with - best_alternative
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
